# Continuous Fuzzing

To Run the Fuzz test use:

```sh
go test -fuzz=FuzzParseString ./go-native-fuzzing -test.fuzzcachedir="../"
```

## Fuzzing using ClutserFuzzLite

Testing ClusterFuzzLite Locally:

```sh
python ../oss-fuzz/infra/helper.py build_image --external $PATH_TO_PROJECT
python ../oss-fuzz/infra/helper.py build_fuzzers --external $PATH_TO_PROJECT --sanitizer address
```

## To generate coverage report from the corpus generated by batch fuzzing

Assuming in Root Directory

First Generate some corpus(better if seed corpus is empty for better visualisation):
```sh
go test -fuzz=FuzzParseString ./go-native-fuzzing -test.fuzzcachedir="."
```

Then create a testdata directory:

```sh
mkdir -p go-native-fuzzing/testdata/fuzz
```

Copy the corpus
```sh
cp -r go-native-fuzzing/FuzzParseString go-native-fuzzing/testdata/fuzz
```

Generate the coverage profile from testdata:

```sh
go test -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
```

Check the coverage profile:

```sh
go tool cover -html=coverage.out -o coverage.html
open coverage.html
```
